name: loft-walk-level
description: (g) LEVEL-ISOLATION-IN-WALK: walking tpl-loft's mezzanine used to hide the storey beneath it. Asserts that walk mode renders TWO storeys where the dollhouse renders one, aims the camera with the dev-only __walkLook lever (pointer lock is unavailable headless), and screenshots the mezzanine. NOTE: the walker cannot be MOVED headlessly (WASD also needs pointer lock), so this cannot frame the view directly over the guard rail — that check is by hand, see TODO.md.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: select-loft-level
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState(); const up=s.floorPlan.upperLevels[0]; s.setViewLevel(up.id); return up.id})()

steps.name: check-probe
steps.eval: (()=>{const p=window.__probe; if(!p) throw new Error('probe did not run'); if(p.mode!=='firstPerson') throw new Error('not walking: '+p.mode); if(p.visible.length!==1) throw new Error('expected one visible level, got '+p.visible); if(p.rendered.length!==2) throw new Error('walk mode should render the storey below too, got '+p.rendered); return p.rendered.join('+')})()

steps.name: look-around
steps.eval: (()=>{const l=window.__walkLook; if(!l||!l.setYaw) throw new Error('__walkLook.setYaw missing — the harness cannot aim a first-person camera without it'); l.setYaw(4.71); l.setPitch(-0.5); return 'aimed'})()
